items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. Anthropic is preparing for an IPO that could value the company at over $1.4 trillion. CoreWeave's stock fell sharply before its Q3 earnings report. The 10-year Treasury yield has risen to 5% due to higher-than-expected inflation data and comments from Federal Reserve official John Waller. Google has released the Pixel Tag, a $30 tracking device for Android users, offering similar functionality to Apple's AirTag.
